description: Standalone Hybrid Computer Vision for Station A tray object sorting: YOLO11n object localization + MobileNetV3-Small classification + OpenCV geometric verification.

detector.name: YOLO11n-StationA-Detector
detector.purpose: Autonomous bounding box localization on full-resolution Station A Android images

operating_constraints.lighting_requirements: controlled diffuse illumination, eliminate harsh diagonal shadows
operating_constraints.camera_view: fixed overhead or angled (approx 60 deg), no motorized tilt required
operating_constraints.placement_guidelines: place triangular prisms so that either the triangular cross-section or longitudinal apex ridge is visible to the overhead camera
operating_constraints.escalation_policy: on NEEDS_REVIEW, return warning status to caller; do not execute automatic robot motion or false WMS placement
